decision: Reject relative-size objective before development evaluation
reason: Neither seed passes the preregistered TRAIN gate. Seed47 public blue localization falls from 5/18 to 3/18, with original-fit blue falling from 96/119 to 95/119. Seed48 public blue improves from 2/18 to 3/18, but public red falls from 2/12 to 1/12. Do not select the more favorable seed or tune against development scenes.
next_direction: Investigate spatial-resolution and center-collision limits on FIT data before increasing model capacity or changing runtime search. Oversized predictions alone do not justify another loss-weight sweep.
scope: Known TRAIN target coverage and host export parity only, not complete-scene accuracy or live Pi readiness
